elevation.philosophy: layered, never both border and shadow on one element

tokens.header-glass: background-color: rgba(9,9,11,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border-bottom: 1px solid #232329

motion.philosophy: one authored moment for the whole page, at first paint
motion.reducedMotion: The entrance keyframes live inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); content is fully visible without them. The demo video does not autoplay and exposes a play control.

browserSurfaces.scrollbar: scrollbar-color: #34343c #09090b; thumb 10px, 3px background-coloured inset border, fully rounded

narrative.northStar: The darkroom — a dark, quiet room whose only light comes from the work pinned to the wall.
narrative.form: Canon (the standing exit), taken deliberately over grounded candidate 4 (Specimen Sheet). Seed key 1dc04a19.
narrative.antiReference: The generic AI-startup landing page: gold/terracotta on near-black, italic serif display accents, tracked monospace eyebrows, 01/02/03 steps, abstract line-art SVG icons, scroll-locked hero animation. The prior version of this site was all of these.
narrative.accentDiscipline: The accent appears only in selection, focus ring, caret and one footer link. Page colour comes from the product's own content.

notCanonized: The 4.15s scroll-locked hero storyboard, the Instrument Serif italic display, the Geist Mono 0.3em-tracked eyebrows, the 01/02/03 numerals and the three hand-drawn use-case SVGs are recorded in Don'ts as removed defects, never as system rules.
The bare 13px label size is used inline rather than promoted to a class; it is a size, not yet a role.
Vercel Analytics and the Intercom widget are site infrastructure, not design tokens; they are noted only because they scope the privacy copy.
